content: Song Won lunged with maximum velocity, executing the 'Southern Edge Absolute Thrust.' Jin did not parry. He initiated the Thirty-Six Movement Plum Blossom Cascade with his winter oak branch. The branch described thirty-six non-linear orbital loops, shattering Song Won's Damascus blade into forty-two fragments.
critique: Sanderson/Gosu: Mathematical cascade vectors, blade fragmentation.

content: Jin moved like the first breath of spring shattering winter's ice. The knotted oak branch in his hands became an instrument of celestial justice, dancing through the petal storm. Wherever the wood touched, steel shattered without sound, turning hardness into light and violence into a prayer.
critique: Rothfuss/Inoue: Sacred poetic grace, celestial justice.

content: Song Won screamed and charged; Jin didn't even drop his sweet potato. *KABLAM!* The oak stick caught the flat of the blade, spun like a windmill, and *CRACK!* snapped the sword into twenty pieces. *WHACK!* The stick bounced off Song Won's forehead, sending him spinning like a top across the stones into Elder Jinbaek's gut, knocking both of them off the arena platform!
critique: Biga/Studio LICO: Windmill spin, spinning top disciple, double bowling pin knockout.
